{{Quote|During my time manning rigs on Subterrel, I'd occasionally use one of the low-volume mining sluices to prepare this tasty stew, made with ripe apple slugs, Ojomian onions, space-carrots and a pinch of negamo. Today, we make the stew more traditionally, in a pot on a nanowave stove, but it's just as flavorful as ever.|Dexter Jettster|<ref name="DAD">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}}</ref>}}
'''Apple slug stew''' was a [[Stew/Legends|stew]] dish consisting of ripe [[apple slug]]s, [[Ojomian onion]]s, [[Carrot/Legends|space-carrots]], and [[negamo]]. These ingredients were cooked together on either a mining sluice or a [[Nanowave stove/Legends|nanowave stove]]. The [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] cook [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] made apple slug stew while working in the mines of [[Subterrel/Legends|Subterrel]] and later offered the stew on the menu of his [[Dex's Diner/Legends|his diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The stew sold for 1.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] per cup and 2.7 credits per bowl.<ref name="DAD" />
